# SIGNAL AT GATE NINE — screenplay excerpt

## INT. WEATHER STATION — NIGHT
MARA, a tired radio operator in an orange storm shell, hears three tones repeat through the emergency receiver. The station windows flex in the wind. A brass key labeled GATE 9 hangs beside the console.

MARA
"Gate Nine, identify yourself."

Only static answers. Mara takes the brass key and crosses to the exterior lock.

## EXT. WEATHER STATION / GATE NINE — NIGHT
Snow drives horizontally. Mara inserts the brass key into a frozen service gate. The three tones stop the instant the key turns.

VOICE (RADIO)
"Do not open it."

Mara freezes with one hand on the gate.

## INT. WEATHER STATION — LATER
Mara returns the key to its hook but leaves a wet glove beneath it as a warning. The receiver remains silent.
